title: Organizations Call for Candidates' Support for Agroecology
subtitle: Paulista Agroecology Articulation, Muda, Permanent Campaign Against Pesticides, and Banquetaço Collective Seek Political Endorsement
excerpt: Agroecology organizations have drafted a document requesting candidates' support for the environmental cause, aiming to strengthen the movement's political presence.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Paulista Agroecology Articulation, the Urban Agroecology Movement (Muda), the Permanent Campaign Against Pesticides, and the Banquetaço Collective have submitted a joint request for support from candidates who advocate for agroecology.

The four entities have drafted a document, made available via a link, in which they ask candidates to take a stand in favor of agroecology and adopt measures that promote this practice.

The request aims to strengthen the agroecological agenda in the political landscape, seeking for elected representatives to incorporate these guidelines into their proposals and actions.

With information from Agência Brasil.
